stage: preparation only; no candidate or final approval
inspectionOrder: Own original, fixed target, family concept and warm-soft style reference visually inspected before frozen-main art feedback, other judges aesthetic criteria or editor rationale. Own saved source collection independently opened and inspected via native inventory. A broad path search returned incidental other-object evidence descriptions; no aesthetic conclusions from them are used.
sourceObservations: Original is a simple narrow central dark barrel with pale metal rail and muzzle on a broad red base. It reads as a functional forward launcher but its block edges and largely uniform surfaces are abrupt and sparse.

At supplied S view the red base is split by the central pale rail into two exposed red side masses. The muzzle reads as an opaque pale octagonal cap; the center barrel has little material separation beyond value.
The saved native collection is four meshes plus a root: base, rail, barrel, muzzle; two action owners are barrel/muzzle. These counts are observations, not design limits.
targetObservations: Target proposes rounded red side canisters, substantial warm yellow-gold cradle/bands and contrasting blue-gray barrel/muzzle. Their overlaps and paired side hinges make construction legible.
Soft broad highlights, rounded transitions and purposeful metal fasteners convey crafted volume. Preserve this hierarchy rather than requiring every small screw at phone scale.
Target detail and inflated width cannot establish attachment fit, root, camera or proportion locks. Native target reconstruction must fit independently measured frozen seat/reservation.
The target front muzzle remains a capped light face. Readable mechanical rim/exit construction may be improved where it preserves identity and function.
styleOutcomes: Rounded but firm manufactured forms, with useful structural improvement permitted.
Clear red/warm gold/cool metal hierarchy; avoid flat weak gray from original and avoid metallic glare that wipes volume.
Warm gentle reflections without one preferred horizontal lighting direction across rotations.
A central moving barrel/muzzle reads at logical and phone sizes while the static cradle remains anchored.
No dark dead areas, seams, z-fighting, clipping, disconnected joints, or detail noise in any required view.
limits: Single target facing is not unseen-view authority.
No approval follows from target or source inspection.
Actual native actions, seat fit, projection and consumer evidence are audited next.
